test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct for using scribers?

options.text: Do not put the scriber in your pocket.
Scriber points are very sharp, so they are to be handled very carefully.
Place a cork on the point when in use to prevent accidents.
While scribing lines, the scriber is used like a pencil.

solution:
The correct answer is __Place a cork on the point when in use to prevent accidents__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Scribers__ are precision tools used for marking lines on workpieces.
 
• The points of scribers are extremely sharp and must be handled with care to avoid injuries.
 
• It is advised to never carry a scriber in your pocket to prevent accidental injuries.
 
• Using a cork on the point of a scriber while in use is not a standard or recommended practice.
 
• While scribing lines, the scriber is held and used like a pencil for precision marking.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Handling and Safety:**

 
 
• Always store scribers in a designated tool holder when not in use.
 
• Inspect the scriber regularly for wear or damage to ensure safety and effectiveness.
 
 
 
• **Usage Tips:**
 
 
• Use a surface plate or flat surface for accurate scribing.
 
• For better visibility, scribe lines can be coated with layout fluid before marking.
